meta.description: Explains how baselines help identify deviations.

question.text: A link usually operates at 25% utilization, but today it remains at 95% during normal business hours. Which monitoring practice helps determine whether this is abnormal?
options: Compare current measurements with an established performance baseline
Replace the router before collecting any more data
Assume high utilization always indicates a cable fault
Clear all logs to establish a new baseline
correctAnswers: Compare current measurements with an established performance baseline
